Bookmark

  • CURIE: gmeow:Bookmark
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Bookmark
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notes

An annotation that records a target resource for later retrieval, motivated by bookmarking. Typically has no body and no selector (the target entity itself is the bookmarked resource).

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Annotation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Bookmark as a specialized kind of gmeow:Annotation. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Annotation
